title: Datadog named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Pipelines
summary: Datadog has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Pipelines.
body_markdown:
Yanbing Li


Chief Product Officer


We’re excited to announce that Datadog has been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Pipelines.


We believe this recognition reflects Datadog’s continued investment in the intelligence we bring to transforming and governing telemetry.


As organizations scale, telemetry is growing faster than the budgets set aside for it. It often arrives in more formats and from more sources than any one team can standardize. AI workloads compound the problem, generating high-volume, high-cardinality telemetry in formats that pipelines were never designed to carry. Observability and Security teams often work from separate copies of the same data, which makes it harder to agree on what to keep and what to drop and where it should land.


[Datadog Observability Pipelines](https://www.datadoghq.com/product/observability-pipelines/) aggregates telemetry from across your environment, standardizes it to the schema your teams already use, and transforms and governs that data before it reaches any destination. Across the Datadog platform, customers can connect what they collect with the observability and security context around it, so decisions about volume and retention are informed by what their teams actually use.


Gartner, Magic Quadrant for Observability Pipelines, Pankaj Prasad, Andre Bridges, Andrea Curry, Neil Young, 12 November 2026 Gartner, Magic Quadrant for Observability Pipelines, Pankaj Prasad, Andre Bridges, Andrea Curry, Neil Young, 12 November 2026


Key Observability Pipelines capabilities include:


-


**Aggregation and standardization:** Collect telemetry from agents, collectors, and open frameworks like OpenTelemetry, and remap it to the schema your teams already work in, including Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) for security data.


-


**Transformation and governance:** Parse, enrich, and redact sensitive fields before data leaves your network, with rules applied consistently across every source.


-


**Volume and cost control:** Filter noise, sample high-volume sources, and archive to lower-cost storage, so you pay for the data you use.


-


**Destination flexibility:** Route the same stream to Datadog, your SIEM, and your archives at once, and change where data lands without reinstrumentation.


Customer feedback plays a key role in analyst evaluations. To us, this recognition reflects how Datadog helps Observability and Security teams aggregate, standardize, and govern their telemetry while keeping control of costs. We’re grateful to the customers who keep sharing their feedback, as it helps us improve our platform and stay focused on the telemetry and observability challenges that matter most.


Learn more about Datadog’s placement and read the full 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Observability Pipelines.

Thank you!
